items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I really liked what he did and I liked him. We became friends

ctx.x: Did you ever have any disagreements with engineers?

Not much. Occasionally. I’m pretty direct about what I want to do. I had like really good engineers that liked my playing, you know I had worked a lot with Jim Anderson, the great engineer that recently is teaching at NYU, the Tisch School. In fact he started their own recording program there 25 years ago or something and he was the engineer for “Jazz Alive” which was based in DC. And they recorded Phil’s group live several times and I really liked what he did and I liked him. We became friends and I had a friend…

what you do so much because people think they know things and most of them don’t. But you know, you have to use my understanding of the music and the technology in editing and so forth. You know we used to cut tape with a razor blade.
